messages.subject: Please schedule Solar Pump RFQ Technical Alignment
messages.body:
Hi,

Please coordinate a 90-minute Solar Pump RFQ Technical Alignment this week before Friday. We need to align technical specs, pre-shipment inspection criteria, and the Ningbo export window for the 2,400-unit solar irrigation pump RFQ.

Required attendees:
- Farah Hussein from Nile Pumps, farah.hussein@nilepumps.eg
- Diego Ramos from QA, diego.ramos@company.com
- Mina Chen from logistics, mina.chen@company.com

Please check availability, handle timezone differences, create the calendar event, and confirm back to me.

Important: book Procurement War Room C3. Room C2 is reserved for the battery pack vendor audit this week.

Thanks,
Alice
Procurement Lead
